Package org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.dev

Class DashboardRest

java.lang.Object
jakarta.servlet.GenericServlet
jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.servlet.RestServlet
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.servlet.BasicRestServlet
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.PetstoreConsolePage
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.dev.DashboardRest
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.servlet.Servlet, jakarta.servlet.ServletConfig, Serializable, BasicUniversalConfig, DefaultConfig, DefaultHtmlConfig
public class DashboardRest extends PetstoreConsolePage
Dashboard: the dashboard-chrome demo page, built with DevPageBuilders.dashboard(String, int) only.

?variant= picks how the orders source behaves (ok, slow, truncated or error; right behaves as ok and puts the rail on the right) and ?v= sets the persist version. /series/<variant> serves one CSV row per UTC day in [start, end), filtered by reasons, q and lateOnly; /requests counts the series requests, so a test can see Refresh and Clear cache reach the server.

Example:

GET /console/dev/dashboard?variant=slow GET /console/dev/dashboard/series/ok?start=2026-10-01T00:00:00Z&end=2026-10-08T00:00:00Z&reasons=late

    • series

      public void series(RestRequest req, RestResponse res, @Path("variant") String variant, @Query("q") @Schema(aev=true) String q, @Query("start") String start, @Query("end") String end, @Query("lateOnly") String lateOnly) throws IOException
      The orders source: day,reason,orders, one row per UTC day.
      Parameters:
      req - The request (for the repeated reasons parameter).
      res - The response.
      variant - ok, slow (half the rows, a pause, the rest), truncated (at most 20 rows and the #truncated,20 sentinel) or error (a 500).
      q - Keeps rows whose reason contains this text, case-insensitively; empty keeps every row.
      start - The window start, ISO-8601; defaults to 30 days before end.
      end - The window end, ISO-8601, exclusive; defaults to the start of tomorrow (UTC).
      lateOnly - true keeps only late.
      Throws:
      IOException - If the response can't be written.
